unit: fingerprint width / cardinality / key family / seed / query mixture

metrics.name: resident_bytes
metrics.means: Retained tracked allocation bytes including the filter object, maximum across five constructions; excludes allocator metadata and freed construction storage.

metrics.name: build_ns
metrics.means: Median construction time in nanoseconds across five paired repetitions for this workload.

metrics.name: lookup_ns
metrics.means: Median nanoseconds per lookup across five paired repetitions for this workload query mixture.

metrics.name: effective_fpr
metrics.tolerance: preregistered non-inferiority anchor per workload: max(nominal 2^-fingerprint_bits, worst retained reference-only point); fixed before any successor solver result and never tuned to submissions
metrics.clears_when: On this workload, the candidate's point and certified bounds are finite/defined and candidate.lower <= anchor[workload][effective_fpr]; the workload fails only when the certified lower bound exceeds the anchor; unresolved domain cannot pass
metrics.means: Worst empirical false-positive probability across five constructions, with certified conservative bounds from eight disjoint absent blocks per construction.

metrics.name: space_overhead_pct
metrics.tolerance: preregistered non-inferiority anchor per workload: worst retained reference-only point; fixed before any successor solver result and never tuned to submissions
metrics.clears_when: On this workload, the candidate's point and certified bounds are finite/defined and candidate.lower <= anchor[workload][space_overhead_pct]; the workload fails only when the certified lower bound exceeds the anchor; unresolved domain cannot pass
metrics.means: Worst defined percent storage overhead relative to the information-theoretic minimum at measured effective FPR, with outward certified bounds; boundary points are undefined.

beats_reference: Every one of five metrics clears on every workload, including added shuffled25%-hit rows: three strict performance wins over the paired reference plus two certified non-inferiority guards against preregistered reference-only anchors; all original and new correctness gates pass. No metric or workload may compensate for another.

statistical_contract.estimator: Worst per-construction empirical k/m across five repetitions; no pooling repeated queries
statistical_contract.interval: Bernoulli KL Chernoff inversion: m*D(k/m || p) <= log(2/alpha); alpha=(1e-6)/360 per construction; worst-value interval takes maxima of lower/upper bounds
statistical_contract.boundary: epsilon=0 or1: space point null, no pseudocount/floor, space predicate false; interval endpoint limits only; epsilon outside[0,1]/nonfinite is invalid
statistical_contract.guard: certified-non-inferiority/v1: a workload clears an accuracy metric when the candidate's certified lower bound does not exceed the preregistered anchor; a filter whose true value is at or below the anchor is rejected with probability at most alpha per construction under the interval's IID assumption; overlapping intervals are never read as equal true values
statistical_contract.resolution: With 8,388,608 absent queries per construction the guard certifies an excess only above about 1.6-1.7x the nominal rate at 16-bit fingerprints and about 1.04x at 8-bit; smaller true differences are indistinguishable at this sample size and are accepted, not endorsed
statistical_contract.calibration: judge/statistical_calibration.json must bind exact measurement sources and >=5 complete reference-only rounds; anchors are per workload: effective_fpr = max(2^-fingerprint_bits, max reference point), space_overhead_pct = max reference point; no successor solver results before freeze
statistical_contract.status: REFERENCE_CALIBRATED; five retained reference-only rounds rederived under certified arithmetic; exact production runtime qualification is a separate gate recorded by judge/statistical_calibration.json and judge/reference/runtime-qualification.json
statistical_contract.arithmetic: Float root proposals are accepted only after directed Decimal interval certification of m*KL >= log(2/alpha); outward space transformation; unchanged point estimator and confidence level

score: Original descriptive mean of 100*R/(C+R) over resident/build/lookup, including every row. The accuracy guards join the strict conjunction independently; numeric score cannot imply PASS.
statement_sentences: Strict PASS requires successful correctness gates and every one of the five metrics to clear independently on every workload; no metric or workload compensates for another. Train feedback exposes candidate absolute summaries and per-metric pass/fail counts, without reference values, preregistered anchors or workload identities.
